message.content: Keysight Technologies Inc, a Technology sector company with two group members, closed at 333.42 on the session of 2026-08-19 following an earnings report dated 2026-08-18 where the actual earnings per share of 2.82 exceeded the estimate of 2.16 by a surprise of 30.56 per cent, resulting in a move of -6.32 per cent. The stock trades at a forward price to earnings multiple of 20.66 and a trailing price to earnings multiple of 45.89, with the latest quarter ending on 2026-07-31 showing revenue of 1.85 billion which grew by 36.5 per cent on a year earlier. The company reported a gross margin of 65.9 per cent and a net income of 397 million for the latest quarter, representing growth of 107.9 per cent on a year earlier compared to operating income growth of 81.4 per cent. Technical indicators show a close near the immediate support high edge of 332.78 with an average true range of 11.05 over 14 days and a relative strength index of 54.21, while the trend state is currently in an uptrend.
